look.label: E-mail look
look.help: Off as shipped (plain e-mails). When on, the shop's offer e-mails get the shop's logo or name at the top, your colours and type face, an optional line under the top and an optional footer line.

banner.label: Cookie banner
banner.help: Off as shipped. When on, a visitor sees a short cookie notice on the first visit, with your words and buttons. The choice is remembered for the days you set.

homeScreen.label: Home-screen icon
homeScreen.help: Off as shipped. When on, a phone that adds the shop to its home screen shows your name, picture and colours.
